en.title: Resume

points: Coursework: Marketing Management, Economics and Business Mathematics, Business Statistics, Organizational Behaviour, International Business, Business Communication, Operations Management.

New-product communication planning: Organized consumer preferences, competitor promotions and social feedback into communication themes for ZUS Coffee. Translated product messages into content topics and consumption scenarios, supporting initial research and promotional content.
Social content execution: Supported the publication of 50 Instagram posts through topic planning, shooting, editing, English copy, hashtags and asset organization.

Channels and performance reviews: Supported the online launch and FamilyMart communication with assets, store information and schedules. Tracked data weekly and completed 15+ content reviews to improve subsequent content; contributed to account follower growth of 11k+.

Market event execution: Arranged university presentations and product trials, preparing teaching cases, FAQs, course materials and demonstrations with product and business teams. Organized on-site activities and Q&A, and consolidated feedback into 10 suggestions for product improvements and subsequent pilots.

Audience research for communication: Maintained user communities and categorized 100+ feedback items on teaching, lesson preparation and self-study needs in mainland and overseas universities. Identified feature, use-case and usage concerns to inform promotional topics and event improvements.

WeChat content operations: Turned features, instructions and use cases into 30+ guides, tutorials, FAQs and examples. Built the product WeChat account from scratch and developed reusable written materials; core-feature usage increased 30% during the internship.
Partnership follow-up: Supported Southeast Asia AI education cooperation, organized partner requirements and followed up on agreement signing and handover.
Coursework: Marketing Analytics, Consumer Behaviour, Marketing Research, Customer Analytics and CRM, B2B Marketing, New Product Marketing.

Market campaign planning: Designed selected online acquisition campaigns around user needs, participation steps and communication by user stage. Converted pricing surveys and feedback into promotional priorities, and supported technology-event publicity, product introductions, materials and on-site execution.
AI copy and dashboards: Used AI to assist promotional copy and content ideation, organize campaign data and create an operations dashboard.

Promotional content: Planned topics around product features, use cases and common questions, delivering 100+ WeChat, Xiaohongshu and community posts. Screened creators by audience profile and engagement, supporting assets, publishing and performance tracking.

Campaign review and optimization: Reached users through communities, WeChat, Xiaohongshu and technology events. Used A/B tests to compare covers, titles and copy and adjust channel budgets and messages. Campaign registrations increased 50% versus the previous week; first-topic creation rate increased approximately 15% relatively.

skills: 2027 Master of Marketing candidate with working English and experience in technology-product content, market promotion and event execution.
Marketing: event planning, promotional copy, product messaging, assets, online and offline communication and partner collaboration.
AI: assisted copy, content ideation, dashboards and data analysis; SOPs, checklists and reusable templates.
Data: Excel, SPSS, SQL (basic); campaign monitoring, channel tests and event reviews.
Content: WeChat, Xiaohongshu and Instagram; Canva, CapCut, Figma (basic).
Execution: cross-team communication, promotional materials, event flow and on-site Q&A; Feishu, DingTalk and Linear.
